Record and fsync complete ownership before create; reconcile only owner-bound jobs, recheck original daemon after absence, and quarantine uncertainty without releasing capacity.
Do not use workstation Docker Desktop/WSL for live evidence; native Linux-only and exact signed pinned runtime only in a disposable GitHub-hosted job.
Test source and installed runtime outside checkout, mandatory twelve live cases with no skip/fallback, compiled-byte bindings and selected evidence upload even on failure.
Preserve launcher/dependencies, original300 roadmap semantics and all full acceptance flags.

Use an initially empty task-owned APT lists directory, readable pinned one-primary keyring, Error-Mode=any and explicit no-insecure/no-unauthenticated options. Independently gpgv the exact fetched InRelease before binding its Packages digest/size and recording signature success. Version floor and package/source pins unchanged.
